card.line: Kedesh in Naphtali was the hometown of Barak, the man Deborah called to lead Israel's army, and the place where he gathered his troops.

moments.title: Barak is summoned from Kedesh
moments.text: Deborah summoned Barak from Kedesh in Naphtali. She told him the LORD, the God of Israel, commanded him to march to Mount Tabor with ten thousand men.

moments.title: Barak gathers the men
moments.text: Deborah went with Barak to Kedesh, where he summoned Zebulun and Naphtali. Ten thousand men followed him, and Deborah went with him too.
